edits.before: "Must be authenticated by the integrating application"
edits.after: "必须由集成应用执行身份认证"
"使用原图像素，不使用屏幕像素。"

edits.before: "Structural checks do not verify the text itself."
edits.after: "结构检查不能验证文本本身。"

edits.before: "The image is 600 by 320 pixels. A box must stay within all four edges."
edits.after: "图片尺寸为 600×320 像素，矩形必须位于四条边界内。 图表限制：矩形控件模型未检查负的左上坐标；检索图使用 JavaScript 小写转换，实际 Python 实现使用 Unicode casefold。超出控件范围或涉及 ß 等字符时，两者结果可能不同。完整路径、类型及索引校验以实际实现为准。"

edits.before: "Valid geometry; the supplied text still requires trust or review."
edits.after: "几何有效；给定文本仍需要信任来源或人工审阅。"

edits.before: "Reject the rectangle rather than clipping evidence."
edits.after: "拒绝该矩形，不裁切证据来迁就校验。"

edits.before: "This is a token-overlap score over provided text. It is not OCR or an answer-confidence estimate."
edits.after: "这是给定文本的词项重叠得分，不执行 OCR，也不估计答案置信度。 图表限制：矩形控件模型未检查负的左上坐标；检索图使用 JavaScript 小写转换，实际 Python 实现使用 Unicode casefold。超出控件范围或涉及 ß 等字符时，两者结果可能不同。完整路径、类型及索引校验以实际实现为准。"

edits.before: `${matches.length} of ${wanted.size} unique query tokens occur in this region.`
edits.after: `此区域命中 ${matches.length} 个词项，查询共 ${wanted.size} 个唯一词项。`
"区分候选提取与已接受证据"

edits.before: "Classification labels remain outside the text index. Human review is an explicit state transition."
edits.after: "分类标签不进入文本索引。人工审阅是明确的状态转移。"
"单独保存候选提取，等待审阅。"

edits.before: "The explicitly reviewed region may enter the text index."
edits.after: "明确审阅后的区域可进入文本索引。"

edits.before: "Keep the overlay aligned as the page resizes"
edits.after: "页面缩放时保持叠加层对齐"

edits.before: "A 600-pixel source image contains box [45,130,510,45]. Source coordinates remain unchanged in JSON."
edits.after: "宽 600 像素的原图包含矩形 [45,130,510,45]。JSON 中的原图坐标保持不变。"

edits.before: "Pixel positions scale for display while percentages remain stable."
edits.after: "显示像素位置随尺寸缩放，百分比保持稳定。"

edits.before: "Apply an explicit signal or transport contract."
edits.after: "应用明确的信号或传输契约。"
"对照播放内容检查转录证据。"

edits.before: "The same sample index produces a different time at a different rate."
edits.after: "同一采样索引在不同采样率下对应不同时间。"
"时间戳 = 采样索引 / 采样率。"

edits.before: "Frame energies are an authored example. Loud noise can pass; quiet words can fail."
edits.after: "帧能量是人工构造的示例。响亮噪声可能通过，轻声语音可能被遗漏。"

edits.before: `Keep ${kept.length} activity segments after the 40 ms minimum.`
edits.after: `应用 40 ms 最小时长后，保留 ${kept.length} 个活动片段。`

edits.before: "Only transient timeouts retry. Supplied reference mode makes no recognition request."
edits.after: "只重试暂时超时。给定参考模式不发送识别请求。"
"超时重试预算已耗尽，保留失败状态。"

edits.before: "No recognizer call; label the supplied transcript."
edits.after: "未调用识别器；明确标记给定转录。"

edits.before: "Record returned text and the exact segment audio hash."
edits.after: "记录返回文本和精确片段音频哈希。"
"multipart model 字段 + WAV 文件"

edits.before: "The review page links segment times to actual playback; it does not infer word alignment."
edits.after: "审阅页将片段时间关联到实际播放，不推断逐词对齐。 图表限制：WebVTT 示意使用 JavaScript Math.round，真实 Python stamp 使用 round；恰好半毫秒时，向上舍入与偶数舍入可能产生 1 毫秒差异。声学图、请求计数和手动开关不能证明语音识别已经执行。"

edits.before: "Reject cue order or an endpoint beyond the audio."
edits.after: "拒绝字幕顺序错误或超出音频范围的端点。"
"编辑 JSON、核验哈希、重新渲染"

edits.before: "Retain the declared source and extraction policy."
edits.after: "保留声明的来源和提取策略。"
"应用有边界且可检查的转换。"

edits.before: "Use | between already extracted blocks. This lab shows phrase filtering after HTML scanning."
edits.after: "用 | 分隔已提取块。本实验展示 HTML 扫描之后的短语过滤。"
`保留 ${kept.length} 个块，原有 ${input.length} 个可读块。`
"统计文本出现次数，不只检查是否存在"

edits.before: "Use | between blocks. Reordering does not count as a text change, but duplicate counts do."
edits.after: "用 | 分隔文本块。重排不算文本变化，但重复次数变化需要记录。"
`共有 ${r.common} 次文本块出现保持不变。`

edits.before: "Do not accept a failed fetch as a baseline"
"HTTP success, supported media, size and cancellation are independent gates."
edits.after: "HTTP 成功、受支持媒体、大小和取消分别构成门禁。 译注：实际 CLI 无条件把新快照写到输出目录的 baseline.json。若 --out 与已有 --baseline 的目录相同，即使没有 --accept，也会覆盖该基线。使用不同的新输出目录；本问题按上游原行为保留，未通过翻译修改。"

edits.before: "Fetch is eligible for extraction. Baseline replacement remains explicit."
edits.after: "获取结果可进入提取步骤；替换基线仍需明确操作。"

edits.before: "Keep the prior baseline and report the fetch failure."
edits.after: "保留原基线并报告获取失败。"

edits.before: "The report carries exact text and counts. It does not infer the publisher’s intent."
edits.after: "报告携带精确文本和次数，不推断发布者意图。"

edits.before: "Review the removed and added statements side by side."
"Inject approved scoped rule with its evidence"
edits.after: "注入已批准且范围匹配的规则及证据"
"会话支持足够，仍需明确审批"

edits.before: "A correction is evidence from a specific session and source locator. Preserve the exact case of API_KEY in the rule; case folding would turn a useful instruction into a contradictory one."
edits.after: "纠正来自特定会话及来源定位信息，是一条证据。保留规则中 API_KEY 的精确大小写；大小写折叠会把有用指令变成相互矛盾的指令。"

edits.before: "Normalize scope for matching, but only collapse rule whitespace. Reject obvious credential-shaped data before it enters the durable store."
edits.after: "规范化 scope 以便匹配；规则只合并空白。明显类似凭据的内容须在进入持久存储前拒绝。"

edits.before: "Which parts of a source excerpt must the caller sanitize before ingestion?"
edits.after: "调用方必须在导入前清理来源引文中的哪些内容？ 图表限制：控件展示会话支持和规则状态，不执行 ingest 的凭据模式／长度检查、真实摘要审批或持久存储。批准状态来自手动选择，不证明存在人工审批记录。"

edits.before: "Repeated delivery is not independent evidence. Two distinct corrections in one session still contribute one supporting session. Keep excerpts and locators with the candidate so its source ids remain resolvable later."
edits.after: "重复投递不是独立证据。同一会话中的两条不同纠正，仍只贡献一个支持会话。将引文及定位信息与候选规则放在一起，使来源 ID 后续仍可解析。"

edits.before: "Deduplicate event ids using their full validated content. Conflicting reuse of an id must fail rather than silently replace provenance."
edits.after: "根据完整已校验内容对事件 ID 去重。同一 ID 的冲突复用必须失败，不能悄悄覆盖来源证据。"

edits.before: "Why should API_KEY and api_key rules remain separate candidates?"
edits.after: "为什么 API_KEY 与 api_key 规则应保持为不同候选？"
"批准并选择限定范围的规则"

edits.before: "Approval applies to an exact candidate digest. A second source can change that digest and force another review. Retiring a rule removes it from emitted context while keeping its evidence available for inspection."
edits.after: "审批针对准确的候选摘要。第二条来源可能改变摘要，需要重新审阅。退役规则后，后续输出上下文不再包含它，但证据仍可检查。"
"批准并选择限定范围的规则"

edits.before: "Apply state and scope filtering together. Never let a global or frequently repeated candidate bypass explicit approval."
edits.after: "同时应用状态和 scope 过滤。不能让 global 候选或高频重复候选绕过明确审批。"

edits.before: "What should the CLI do when the user supplies yesterday's digest after new evidence arrived?"
edits.after: "新证据到达后，用户仍提供昨天的摘要，CLI 应如何处理？"

edits.before: "The CLI captures JSONL corrections, saves a versioned store, reloads it in another process and emits a neutral JSON hook payload. It retains evidence, supports retirement and preserves API_KEY exactly across restart."
edits.after: "CLI 收集 JSONL 纠正并保存带版本的存储，再由另一个进程重新加载，输出中立的 JSON hook 载荷。它保留证据、支持退役，并在重启后精确保留 API_KEY。"

edits.before: "Write a unique sibling temporary file and rename. This store has a single-writer contract; add locking before using simultaneous writers."
edits.after: "写入唯一的同目录临时文件后重命名。此存储契约只允许单写者；支持同时写入前先增加锁。"

edits.before: "How would your agent integration map additional_context into its documented hook wire format?"
edits.after: "你的智能体集成如何将 additional_context 映射到文档规定的 hook 消息格式？"

figureLimitations.web-change-brief: 译注：实际 CLI 无条件把新快照写到输出目录的 baseline.json。若 --out 与已有 --baseline 的目录相同，即使没有 --accept，也会覆盖该基线。使用不同的新输出目录；本问题按上游原行为保留，未通过翻译修改。

preservedMachineNotes.typed-workflow-agent-with-mastra: 译注：分类词表、工具查询、模拟响应、状态、错误及计划摘要契约保留原值，中文页面不代表支持中文意图识别。手写检查点可由本地 CLI 重放，但不具有真实 SDK 的持久审批或身份认证能力；可选 Mastra 运行须单独安装依赖并验证。
preservedMachineNotes.visual-evidence-library: 译注：原图和给定文本区域保持不变；本次汉化没有执行 OCR 或真实视觉模型。JSON 方法、来源与错误字段保留原契约。无命中提示保留原测试所需英文，并附中文。视觉端点适配器只检查 HTTP(S) 协议，未采用语音适配器的远程 HTTPS／禁止重定向策略；不应上传敏感图片。
preservedMachineNotes.voice-note-transcriber-pipeline: 译注：音频、字幕文本、WAV／WebVTT／JSON 字段、哈希、服务商参数与方法标记保留原值。离线参考模式和人工审阅模式不执行语音识别；页面文案汉化不会改变录音或原字幕。
preservedMachineNotes.web-change-brief: 译注：输入网页、精确变化文本、JSON 字段、校验和及错误消息保留原值。没有新增后台监测；命令行固定展示与帮助已译。空变化及未变计数提示保留原测试需要的英文并附中文。
preservedMachineNotes.workflow-hooks: 译注：规则文本、来源引文、API_KEY 大小写、摘要、状态、CLI 子命令和 additional_context 保留原值。测试仅在隔离文件中生成、批准、退役候选，没有安装真实 hook 或改变当前智能体指令。
